candidates.text: Today's hearing is being held in pursuance to temporary amendments to the open meeting law. That is what allows us to meet virtually.
Do you swear to tell the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth?
Uh my first question is for Sergeant McNulty. When you walked into the establishment and saw the 25 people seated, did they seem concerned for their safety that they were waiting for rides together?
Okay. And did you receive any resistance from them or any problems with the with them when you delivered that?
Uh we did not. I realize we should have, but uh at that time we were still trying to figure out what had occurred.
Those are all the items before the board this morning. The board is set to vote this Thursday, um, due to a scheduling conflict. The vote will be at 12:00 p.m., 12:00 noon, rather than 10:00 a.m.
